steps.title: Explore the version graph
steps.text: Each window is a version of your hierarchy. Click a version to activate it, or double-click to focus it.

items: Drag empty graph space to pan.
Use arrow keys to navigate versions.

steps.title: Create an entry
steps.text: Select the New entry button to open the editor. You can cancel the editor or create an entry.

steps.title: Work with entries
steps.text: Click entries to select them, then use the context menu or toolbar to edit the hierarchy.

items: Use Add child or Add parent to build a hierarchy.
Drag an entry onto another to attach it.

steps.title: Find and share your work
steps.text: Search versions with Ctrl/⌘+F. Use Settings to export data, import a local copy, or list version tags.
steps.instruction: You can restart this tutorial from the help button at any time.
